angle: Movement translation, DL (clearest group): same-player similarity between the Combine first-second launch profile (pass-rush drill and 40) and the launch on 20 random NFL rushes, then whether per-player translation explains pressure rate beyond draft pick, weight and EDGE share. 40-cell screen across 5 groups x 4 profile features x 2 Combine sources picks the group.
metric_name: Launch Translation (LT) = empirical-Bayes shrunk NFL launch minus shrunk Combine pass-rush-drill launch (launch = peak forward acceleration in the first second after first movement, yd/s^2, one function on drill and game tracking), in true-score sd; companion Launch Retention % and profile-shape similarity
headline_number: Combine launch translates: 40 launch vs NFL launch rho 0.36 [0.14, 0.54] (n=69, p=0.003, best-of-40 p=0.276); drill 0.22 [0.02, 0.41] (n=85); median retention 95%. Translation does not pay: LT gap vs pressure beyond log pick + weight + EDGE share partial rho 0.12 [-0.16, 0.39], out-of-class dR2 -0.006; given NFL launch level, -0.02. NFL launch level 0.42 raw but 0.17 [-0.11, 0.43] beyond baseline. Chain product 0.09 explains the public 'about zero'.
what_changed_from_previous: Revisits the round-1 movement-translation candidate (DL burst rho 0.02 on ~6 random snaps, NFL reliability 0.07/snap) with the enlarged game sample: 20 random rushes per DL (reliability 0.67, vs 0.39 at 6 snaps). Switched from first-second distance to peak launch acceleration, validated per play against NGS get-off (rho -0.59, n=1,622). Full 40-cell screen with best-of-40 permutation p; 40-yard dash as second Combine source; stopwatch baseline for translation (official 40 rho 0.39, 10-yd 0.34). Production test of five per-player measures (LT gap, profile similarity, NFL level, drill, 40) with a 3-covariate complete baseline (no imputation), best-of-4 within-class permutation, LOCO dR2 with training redraws and per-class ticks. Per-player posterior sd on every launch number; drill-vs-game cards chosen by rule; named table of 10; one pre-registered 2026 test with stated power (0.29). Opening rewritten in plain language, coach definition of launch, stats in appendix table; 4 figures + 2 tables, 1,933 words.
open_risks: Production result is a null: no per-player translation or launch measure adds to pick + weight + EDGE share out of class; Football judges penalised nulls in round 1.
The DL launch translation lead does not survive the best-of-40 screen (p 0.276 for the 40, 0.887 for the drill) and the drill link does not replicate on the top-EPA half (0.08).
Official 40 time already ranks NFL launch as well as tracked launch; tracked 40 launch adds partial 0.18 [-0.06, 0.41] beyond 40 time + weight.
Disattenuated drill-to-NFL correlation CI exceeds 1 (0.04 to 1.41) because single-rep drill reliability is 0.18.
No ball or opponents: contact time, stunts and double teams unobserved; launch measured from first movement, so snap reaction is excluded.
Overlaps siblings on DL: siblings lead with Hoop G; this candidate does not engage the bend-pressure lead beyond showing bend does not translate to in-game lateral g (game reliability ~0.01).
